boundary: Force, wearing, day, user and posture arise from different public datasets, rates, labels and splits; day and user share GRABMyo records. ROAM posture target subjects are unseen and differ from resting source subjects, so source-to-target user and posture shifts coexist. Five-axis mean is descriptive, not pooled accuracy; own 250 Hz device, speed and real signal quality remain unobserved for this exact bank.
